title: Midnight Club: Street Racing arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2000, Midnight Club: Street Racing became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2000, Midnight Club: Street Racing became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the racing category, Midnight Club: Street Racing broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
